acceptance_criteria: inspect all five product repositories plus project-orchestrator before portfolio decisions
apply P0-P6 priority and anti-stall rotation from current authority
attempt concrete product advancement when safe eligible work exists
never promote or merge through failed, pending, missing-required-check, conflicted, or materially uncertain gates
persist evidence-backed KPI telemetry without counting telemetry as product advancement

evidence_sources: fresh pull-request CI on the exact head
live GitHub mergeability, review, comment, and required-check state
repository-specific policy and Product Reality gates

protected_invariants: product repository authority overrides portfolio KPI optimization
control-plane work never counts as product advancement
external actor progress never counts as current-run orchestrator advancement
UNKNOWN is never coerced to zero or success
throughput floor cannot weaken quality, security, licensing, provenance, privacy, or architecture gates

evidence_sources: specialist review when risk class requires it

authoritative_sources: each product repository roadmap, architecture, CI, policy, licensing/provenance, and Product Reality authority

automated_actions: run authorized FAST_GATE and full preflight
open a ready pull request only after required exact-head preflight is green
repair a failing branch within bounded policy
merge an objectively green pull request when all repository gates are satisfied
record issue-ledger transitions and KPI telemetry
human_only_actions: major architecture change not already authorized
new paid service or meaningful recurring cost
credential or secret action requiring the user
materially ambiguous requirement with meaningfully different outcomes

upstream_inspiration.adaptation_rule: concepts only; project-orchestrator authority and DoWork semantics remain canonical
